name: cash.statements.end_of_day

list.description: Read end-of-day statements for explicit account, currency and value-date scope.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Explicit account aliases; native bankAccountAliasName array.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Inclusive value date start, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive value date end, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

purpose: Inspect bank statement records without aggregating currencies, inferring fund direction or changing source data.

fields.name: valueDate
fields.meaning: Source value date; distinct from transaction date and capture time.

fields.name: bankTransNo
fields.meaning: Native transaction number; retained in composite identity.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Unscaled native amount; null, empty text and zero are distinct.

fields.name: fundDirection
fields.meaning: Source fund direction; never inferred from the amount sign.

identity_description: Typed native composite identity preserves distinct institution/account/currency/value-date/transaction records. Duplicated composite identities fail rather than collapsing records.
limitations: Fixed tenant GUAPW3SG, POST rowStart pagination at pageSize=1000 and timezone GMT+08.
Explicit entity/account alias/currency and inclusive date bounds are required for acquisition; cached replay needs no repeated scope.
Native rows retain exact values, unknown fields, dates and array order. Legacy whitelist field loss is corrected.
Total is data.totalCount and remains fixed across pages; malformed identities, duplicate rows and out-of-scope records fail.
No native detail action or offline scope filter is declared; default list is offline.

examples.title: Read scoped statements
examples.command: dogopencli liquidity list cash.statements.end_of_day --live --entity Z21 --account-alias ACCOUNT_ALIAS --currency USD --from-date 2026-10-01 --to-date 2026-10-01 --limit 0

sync.evidence: Typed native composite identity preserves distinct institution/account/currency/value-date/transaction records. Duplicated composite identities fail rather than collapsing records. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.

time.basis: Inclusive value date start, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.
